entries.title: Exodus 22:1
segments: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it or sell it, he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

entries.title: Exodus 22:2
segments: If a thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, no blood [shall be] shed for him.

entries.title: Exodus 22:3
segments: If the sun is risen upon him, blood is due for him. He should repay in full. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

entries.title: Exodus 22:4
segments: If the theft is certainly found in his hand alive, whether it is an ox, or an ass, or a sheep, he shall restore double.

entries.title: Exodus 22:5
segments: If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his animal, and shall feed in another man's field; he shall repay from the best of his own field, and the best of his own vineyard.

entries.title: Exodus 22:6
segments: If fire breaks out and catches in thorns, so that the stacks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field, is burned up, he who kindled the fire shall surely repay in full.

entries.title: Exodus 22:7
segments: If a man shall deliver to his neighbor silver or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man's house; if the thief is found, let him pay double.

entries.title: Exodus 22:8
segments: If the thief is not found, then the master of the house shall be brought to the judges, whether he has put his hand to his neighbor's goods.

entries.title: Exodus 22:9
segments: For every case of trespass, for ox, for ass, for sheep, for clothing, for any kind of lost thing, which [another] claims to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges. Whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double to his neighbor.

entries.title: Exodus 22:10
segments: If a man delivers to his neighbor an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies, or is hurt, or driven away, no one seeing,

entries.title: Exodus 22:11
segments: an oath of the LORD shall be between them both, that he has not put his hand to his neighbor's goods. And the owner of it shall accept it, and he shall not make [it] good.

entries.title: Exodus 22:12
segments: And if it is stolen from him, he shall fully repay the owner of it.

entries.title: Exodus 22:13
segments: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for witness, [and] he shall not make good that which was torn.

entries.title: Exodus 22:14
segments: And if a man borrows from his neighbor, and it is hurt, or dies, and the owner of it not with it, he shall surely make [it] good.

entries.title: Exodus 22:15
segments: If the owner of it [is] with it, he shall not make [it] good. If it is hired, it came for its hire.

entries.title: Exodus 22:16
segments: And if a man lures a virgin who is not promised, and lies with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

entries.title: Exodus 22:17
segments: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

entries.title: Exodus 22:18
segments: You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

entries.title: Exodus 22:19
segments: Anyone lying with an animal shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 22:20
segments: One sacrificing to a god, except it is to Jehovah only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

entries.title: Exodus 22:21
segments: You shall neither vex a stranger nor oppress him, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 22:22
segments: You shall not afflict any widow or fatherless child.

entries.title: Exodus 22:23
segments: If you afflict them in any way, and they cry at all to Me, I will surely hear their cry.

entries.title: Exodus 22:24
segments: And My wrath shall become hot, and I will kill you with the sword, and your wives shall be widows, and your sons fatherless.

entries.title: Exodus 22:25
segments: If you lend money to one of My people who [is] poor beside you, you shall not be to him as a money-lender, neither shall you lay upon him interest.

entries.title: Exodus 22:26
segments: If you at all take your neighbor's clothing as a pledge, you shall deliver it to him by the time the sun goes down.

entries.title: Exodus 22:27
segments: For that [is] his covering only, it is his clothing for his skin. In what shall he sleep? And it will be, when he cries to Me, I will hear, for I [am] gracious.

entries.title: Exodus 22:28
segments: You shall not revile God, nor curse the ruler of your people.

entries.title: Exodus 22:29
segments: You shall not delay [to offer] the first of your ripe fruits and of your sap. You shall give the first-born of your sons to Me.

entries.title: Exodus 22:30
segments: Likewise you shall do with your oxen [and] with your sheep; it shall be with its dam seven days. On the eighth day you shall give it to Me.

entries.title: Exodus 22:31
segments: And you shall be holy men to Me. Neither shall you eat flesh torn by beasts in the field. You shall throw it to the dogs.
